parameters.content:
Run this ONCE to load your existing 105-game collection (titles, genres, descriptions, expansions) into the Data Table. Each row is tagged game_id = manual-g<N>, so re-running is safe (upsert, no duplicates).

If you later also run "Sync from BGG", BGG games are tagged bgg-<bggid> — a game you own that also exists on BGG will show up TWICE (once as manual-gN, once as bgg-<id>) until you manually delete the manual-gN duplicate from the Data Table. There is no automatic title-matching/merge in this version.

  game_id: "manual-g" + g.num,
  bgg_id: null,
  num: g.num,
  title: g.title,
  genre: g.genre,
  type: g.type,
  desc: g.desc,
  expansions: JSON.stringify(g.expansions || []),
  desire_to_play: 0,
  thinning_candidate: false,
  bgg_rating: null,
  photo_url: null,
  added_at: now,
  updated_at: now
} }));

nodes.notes: After import: pick your Data Table, operation "Upsert Row", match column game_id. Runs once per incoming item (105 games) automatically.
